# how-to-web Carousel

> Reconstruction guidance for the how-to-web Carousel organism.

Use [Build DNA](./build-dna.json) as the normative contract. The three examples demonstrate different carousel problems; no example replaces the generic contract.

- [Build DNA](./build-dna.json)
- [Carousel reference](./index.md)

## Agent instruction

Preserve sequence meaning, native controls, focus behavior, hidden-content accessibility, reduced-motion support and explicit autoplay/wrapping decisions. Adapt framework, layout and visual tokens to the target project. Do not infer interaction rules from visual examples.
